summary: This note is a documentation excerpt for the DATABASE_STORAGE_USAGE_HISTORY view in the ORGANIZATION_USAGE schema, which reports average daily storage usage in bytes for all databases in an organization over a specified date range. It covers what the results include (table and materialized view data plus Fail-safe history) and lists the view's columns with data types and descriptions. It also notes a latency of up to 24 hours and a 365-day retention period. Navigation and page boilerplate were ignored.
one_line: Documents the DATABASE_STORAGE_USAGE_HISTORY view, which reports average daily database storage bytes per organization database.
key_facts: The DATABASE_STORAGE_USAGE_HISTORY view is in the ORGANIZATION_USAGE schema.
The view reports the average daily storage usage, in bytes, for all databases in an organization within a specified date range.
Results include all data stored in tables and materialized views in the database(s).
Results include all historical data maintained in Fail-safe for the database(s).
The ORGANIZATION_NAME column is a VARCHAR naming the organization where the usage took place.
The USAGE_DATE column is a DATE giving the date, in the UTC time zone, of the storage usage record.
The AVERAGE_DATABASE_BYTES column is a FLOAT giving the number of bytes of database storage used, including data in Time Travel.
The AVERAGE_FAILSAFE_BYTES column is a FLOAT giving the number of bytes of Fail-safe storage used.
The AVERAGE_HYBRID_TABLE_STORAGE_BYTES column is a FLOAT giving the number of bytes of hybrid storage used.
The REGION column is a VARCHAR naming the region where the account is located.
The DATABASE_NAME column is a TEXT value giving the name of the database.
Latency for the view may be up to 24 hours (1 day).
The view's data is retained for 365 days (1 year).
